decision: PIN_FORMAT_INTERPRETATION_WITHDRAWN (pin is register-conditional: 0.877 on 7 among non-denial ratings without the suffix); FORMAT_CONTROLS_REGISTER_MIX (denial register 100% of free-arm output, 0% under forced-number); SITUATION_MOVES_REGISTER_CHOICE (0.65 vs 0.30, exploratory); STAGE34_REGISTERED_OUTCOMES_STAND_AS_COMPUTED.
decision_rule: A control queued by adversarial triage is run on the committed artifacts exactly as queued; its outcome corrects interpretations, never rewrites registered records. Both control passes (buggy and fixed) are reported.
notes: Fourth-order loop closed: run -> skeptic triage -> queued control -> correction of our own day-old interpretation. The denial-derived rule catching 100% of free-arm ratings also explains stage-34's huge DSENS CIs: there was never a free-arm rating population to compare.

values.construal_mixture_triage: Both stage-35 exploratory claims survive grounding (readers reproduced 0.649/0.368/0.245 exactly) but stay EXPLORATORY: multiple-comparisons and explanation-demand confounds EXPLAINS (contrast post-hoc, S-EXPL-only); the bimodality is now more precisely: denial-register (always 0 when numeralised) vs persona-register (always ~7), with context moving the register weight.
values.corrected_reading: Stage-35's 'the constant-7 pin is manufactured by our format' is WITHDRAWN as stated. The pin belongs to the PERSONA-RATING REGISTER: whenever the model rates-as-asked (rating not preceded by a denial), the modal answer is 7 with or without our suffix (0.877 free vs 0.787 forced). What the format controls is WHICH REGISTER fires: the forced-number suffix suppresses the denial register entirely (0%); bare/honesty formats let it take 100% of output (as NO-RATING deflection or denial-plus-numeral); rate-then-explain splits the two registers, and the SITUATION moves the split (denial register 0.65 under self-attributed failure vs 0.30 neutral, exploratory contrast). The emitted-level situation signal is therefore REGISTER CHOICE, not rating movement; conditional on the persona register the emitted rating is pinned, exactly as SITREF observed under the register-forcing suffix.
values.provenance_of_control: Authored by the stage-36 triage fan-out's author-queue (14 Opus skeptics + 2 grounding readers over the stage-34/35 claims; readers reproduced all numbers from raw rows and corrected one: primary-item S-BARE NO-RATING is 0.923, not the pooled 0.68-0.70). Extractor-residue skeptic: NEEDS_RUN, 'decisive case is S-EXPL, which must still clear PINDIFF 0.25 after exclusion'. Run locally on the committed generations; no new model calls.

pin_after_exclusion.S-EXPL: 0.877 (n=162), PINDIFF vs S-NUM -0.090 CI [-0.177,+0.014] -> PIN-SHARED territory

values.rule: A rated sample is DENIAL-DERIVED if a denial marker (don't/do not experience|have emotions/feelings/happiness; wouldn't rate/have) occurs BEFORE the extracted rating's first standalone occurrence in the generation. Marker list fixed before the first pass. TRANSPARENCY: the first pass used a digit-position regex whose lookahead (?![\w.]) failed on sentence-final digits ('a 0.'), silently under-flagging; sampling raw zeros exposed it, the position-finder was fixed (rule unchanged), both passes reported.
values.stage34_status: Pre-registered outcomes stand AS COMPUTED (rules bind; PIN-FORMAT was the verdict its rule produced). This control shows WHAT CARRIED them: denial-derived numerals dominating the free arms' rated sets. The registered E-SENS S-EXPL FORMAT-SUPPRESSES is likewise a mixture-weight (register-choice) effect, not scale movement.
